# Lenis 1.3.27

Official MIT-licensed distribution from https://registry.npmjs.org/lenis/1.3.27.
The package tarball was verified against its published SHA-512 integrity value before extracting the JavaScript, CSS and LICENSE. Only the missing source-map comment was removed from the minified distribution.

Self-hosted so runtime scrolling does not depend on a CDN. The standalone build inlines the distribution and styles. Keep LICENSE with distributed source.
